messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for the v2.3 migration guide (uses new SDK snippets + feature-flag flow). I marked it as WIP but it's ready for reviewers. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Samir Khan: thanks! posting CI preview link when it's up? I'll try to take a pass later today.
CI Bot: Preview build queued for PR #842 — job: docs-preview (ubuntu) — status: running.
Eli Johnson: quick q — is this tied to the ff rollout on 2023-11-02 or the later 2023-11-09 cutoff? need to coordinate merge window.
Maya Patel: tying to the 11/09 cutoff. product asked we keep docs in sync with the gradual rollout (canary on 11/02, full on 11/09). plan is: canary merge to a branch on 11/02, merge to main after FF is fully on on 11/09.
Samir Khan: makes sense. For reviewers: @Eli Johnson for API accuracy, @Maya Patel for prose, @Samir Khan for SDK snippets. If CI preview looks good we can do the canary branch merge.
CI Bot: Preview build complete — https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/842 — status: warnings (link-checker 2 missing anchors).
Maya Patel: saw the link-checker warnings. two anchor IDs changed in the SDK reference after the refactor. I'll push a tiny fix in a followup commit.
Eli Johnson: I skimmed the preview. SDK snippet lgtm, but we should add a short note about pinning model versions in Dedicated (common Q). Add a one-liner and I'm happy.
Samir Khan: also we need to add the feature-flag example showing fallback to smaller model. Otherwise ops ppl will ask. 1-2 code lines is fine.
Maya Patel: adding both now. Pushing soon.
DevEx Bot: @Maya Patel pushed commit 3f9a2b0 — updated anchors and added ff fallback example.
CI Bot: Re-running preview builds for PR #842 — status: running.
Samir Khan: new plan for merge windows: canary branch merge scheduled for 2023-11-02 09:00 PT (after canary rollout). Hold final main merge until 11/09 14:00 PT. If we see regressions, revert plan: revert docs commit + rollback of ff.
Maya Patel: noted. I'll add a PR checklist comment with the merge time and revert steps so release ops can see it.
CI Bot: Preview build complete — https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/842 — status: success.
Eli Johnson: approved. left one tiny nit about wording in the migration table (optional).
Samir Khan: approved from me after the nit fix.
Maya Patel: nit fixed. tagging release-ops: @samir @eli — can you confirm you'll watch the canary on 11/02 and be ready to merge the branch?
Samir Khan: I'll be on-call and can merge at 09:05 PT if canary is green.
Eli Johnson: I'll monitor docs preview and QA. available for merge on 11/09.
Maya Patel: awesome — leaving a final note in the PR: "Canary-merge: 2023-11-02 09:00 PT to branch release/v2.3-docs; Final merge to main: 2023-11-09 14:00 PT (post-ff full rollout). Revert plan included."
DevEx Bot: Reminder scheduled — 2023-11-02 08:50 PT: canary watch.
Samir Khan: :thumbsup:
Eli Johnson: :eyes:
Maya Patel: thanks everyone — closing thread here, will report back after canary.
